I made one small rewrite to the `assistant-chain` proposal and logged it in `flags.jsonl` as "rewrote". The text-check script flagged nothing, and I didn't shoot any pages, since it's a proposal.

The "What exists" paragraph was about 80 words, over the 60-word limit. I split it into four short bullets for roles, classes, Refine and Dictate. The rest is brief-style text for agents and reads clearly. The numbered deliverables are short enough as written.
